scope: Classical energy and zero-mean Gauss reduction of K1346--K1347 scalar electrodynamics, with positive nonzero linearized BRST cohomology at the vacuum; not GU physical positivity or a nonlinear Hilbert-cohomology theorem.

constrained_reduction.phase_space: A,phi in H1(T3) and E,Pi in L2(T3), with H_ps-valued phi and Pi
constrained_reduction.gauge_group: zero-mean H2(T3;R) phases acting by A maps to A+d chi and phi maps to exp(i e chi)phi
constrained_reduction.topological_sector: the zero-mean trivial-holonomy connection sector excludes harmonic flat-potential zero modes
constrained_reduction.positivity: for m>0 and lambda>0 every term is nonnegative and H vanishes only on the vacuum modulo the declared zero-mean gauge group
constrained_reduction.gauge_descent: H and the Gauss surface are gauge invariant, so H descends to gauge classes
constrained_reduction.nonempty_nonzero_class: A=0, a nonzero smooth real-line-valued phi, Pi=0 and any transverse E satisfy Gauss and define nonvacuum classes
constrained_reduction.vacuum_linearization: at A=phi=0 the complex is free zero-mean Maxwell BRST direct-sum a massive complex H_ps-valued Klein-Gordon matter field
constrained_reduction.linearized_cohomology: two transverse photon polarizations per nonzero mode plus the complex massive H_ps matter modes
constrained_reduction.linearized_pairing: the quadratic Hamiltonian is strictly positive on nonzero linearized cohomology classes
constrained_reduction.nonlinear_status: a positive conserved classical energy on the formal Gauss quotient is constructed; closed nonlinear orbit space, global large-data evolution and quantum completion are not

claim_ceiling: The repository control has a positive gauge-invariant interacting Hamiltonian, a nonempty Gauss reduction and positive nonzero vacuum-linearized BRST cohomology on the declared zero-mean trivial-holonomy sector. It does not construct a closed nonlinear physical Hilbert quotient, global large-data evolution, quantization or GU physical cohomology.
